journal_files.description: List of additional journal file paths to include. If empty, defaults to using the primary journal file via environment variables or default paths.

alias_rules.description: List of account alias rules. Each rule has fields 'old' (string) and 'new' (string). Aliases rewrite account names in reports and commands.

commodities.description: List of commodity declarations. Each entry has 'symbol' (string) and optional 'style' (string). The style controls display formatting (e.g., '$1,000.00'). Required for consistent parsing and display, and for strict-mode error checking.

decimal_mark.description: Decimal mark character to use for parsing numbers ('.' or ','). Overrides per-commodity inference when present.

accounts.description: List of account declarations. Each entry has 'name' (string, required), optional 'type' (string: one of A, L, E, R, X, C, V), and optional 'tags' (map of key-value pairs). Declaring accounts helps with error checking and defines display order.

default_year.description: Default year for parsing dates without explicit years (e.g., '12/31' becomes '2000-12-31' if default_year=2000). Set via Y directive.

payees.description: List of known payee names (strings). Required only if using payee error checking (strict mode or hledger check payees).

tags.description: List of allowed tag names (strings). Required only if using tag error checking (strict mode or hledger check tags).
